name: okf-reader
description: Loads OKF knowledge bundles into Claude Code sessions, lazily and by declared authority.

standards_bundle.title: Organization standards bundle
standards_bundle.description: Path to a normative OKF bundle applied to every project. Deploy via managed settings so a repository cannot override it.

cache_dir.title: Vendored bundle cache
cache_dir.description: Where remote bundles are vendored, relative to the project root. The hook never fetches over the network; it only reads this directory.

context_budget.title: Startup context budget
context_budget.description: Maximum characters injected at session start. Claude Code spills anything above 10000 to a file.
